statement: Any person, partnership, association or corporation may incorporate under the DGCL by filing a certificate of incorporation, and the certificate must set forth the matters required by 8 Del. C. § 102(a): a corporate name containing one of the required words or abbreviations (association, company, corporation, club, foundation, fund, incorporated, institute, society, union, syndicate, or limited) that is distinguishable upon the records of the Division of Corporations; the registered office address and registered agent in Delaware; the nature of the business or purposes; the stock authorization (classes, number of shares, par value); and the name and mailing address of each incorporator.
caveat: Section 102(a)(1) carries exceptions and consent mechanics for name availability, and 102(b) optional provisions materially shape governance — counsel drafts the certificate. Verify the current statutory text before filing.
